characterList.description: A woman with brown hair wearing a pink-flowered shirt, blue jeans, grey sneakers and pink floral gloves. She is using a metal detector and a shovel.

characterList.description: A man with a beard and short, dark hair. He is wearing a black polo shirt with a yellow and turquoise logo, brown pants, and a brown camouflage cap. He uses a metal detector and digs with his hands.
characterList.name: Man

youtube_description:
Another trip out with dueling detectors (etrac and deus). Once all the markers were out I simply went around and dug all the targets. Unfortunately the hunt was blighted by rain and you will see toward the end just how wet I got, lol
Check out Tracking Treasures channel here and tell her Pondguru sent you: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC0HtfOWCl1Opb5f9YCEszMw
Great metal detecting supplies here: http://www.kingdigger.co.uk
Thanks to everyone who takes time out to watch and like my videos - much appreciated.
Plenty more to come and I'm loving making these videos.
Groovy.
GL&HH to all viewers - even the ass clowns who hit the dislike button.
Music in this video is 'Burning times' by Inkubus Sukkubus
